records.observation: Drawable subclass with Coord array and cached final index. Sized and copy constructors set last index; both copies allocate array and copy each Coord, confirming Shadow copy vertex independence. Array-input constructor explicitly sets supplied time bounds, creates Coord objects using matching lineID indices or i/2 when lengths differ, but never sets last_vtx_idx (new-object default zero), and does not validate alternate array length or recompute bounds. Default has null vertices. Size inherited+2+12 per vertex. Writer narrows length to signed short and uses narrowed count as loop bound without range check; reader allocates signed-short count, fills coordinates, caches final index and expands inherited bounds without explicit reset. Setters store references and expand bounds; setVertices requires same length, exposes supplied array, does not recompute cached final index. Getters expose array/Coord references. LineID list/array copy boxed IDs in vertex order, preserving duplicates; this confirms shadow grouping key order. isTimeOrdered checks inherited bounds then each vertex up to cached final index using contains; does not compare adjacent vertex times. Diagnostics call toString; toString prints inherited info, all coordinates and byte size. Drawing/hit methods use first/final vertex times, state row/nesting factor, arrow mapped endpoint rows, event first vertex time and row-centered extent; delegates State/Arrow/Line/Event. Search delegates category visibly-searchable flag. Null/zero-size, narrowing and unset-cache paths are local observations, not proof of normal caller failures. Archived application not executed.
